name: amfx-usdcnh-rate-spread-research
description: amFX reproduction (25OCT22 p4): USDCNY (FRED: DEXCHUS) vs US 10-Year Treasury Yield overlay. Original chart showed USDCNH vs US-China 10Y rate differential. China 10Y yield not on FRED; US 10Y used as proxy (dominant driver of spread widening 2021-2022). DEXCHUS used for USD/CNY spot (CNH offshore rate not on FRED). Demonstrates 'early is a synonym for wrong'. Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: USDCNH VS RATE DIFFERENTIAL (25OCT22 p4)
# =============================================================================
# "Early is a synonym for wrong" — Brent Donnelly
# Rate differential moved first, USDCNH lagged for months before
# violently catching up. The "Evergrande is China's Lehman moment!"
# annotation marks a false alarm; the real move came from rates.
#
# NOTE: China 10Y yield not on FRED. Using US 10Y as proxy since
# it was the dominant driver of the spread widening (US yields surged
# from ~1.5% to ~4.3% while China 10Y was relatively stable ~2.5-3%).
# NOTE: USDCNH not available as Polygon asset. Using FRED DEXCHUS
# (Chinese Yuan per USD, daily) as proxy for USDCNY/USDCNH.
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA: FRED Economic Indicators
# =============================================================================

# USDCNY spot (daily, FRED: DEXCHUS — Chinese Yuan per USD)
usdcny_src = economic_indicators(series_id='DEXCHUS')()
usdcny = ffill(usdcny_src.result)

idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: USDCNY Spot Rate
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='USDCNY: FX Eventually Follows Rates (But Timing Matters)',
    category='USDCNH vs Rates',
    y_axis_label='USDCNY',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='USDCNY (DEXCHUS)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, usdcny)
